notifications.clipboard_empty: The clipboard holds no text to print.
notifications.no_default: No default printer. Pick one in the panel first.
notifications.printer_stopped: {printer} has stopped. Check the printer, then re-enable it from CUPS.

panel.add_note: Added as driverless IPP Everywhere queues. A printer that needs a vendor driver has to be set up in Printer settings instead.
panel.already_added: Already set up as a queue
panel.no_devices: No printers found on the network or USB

cups_url.description: The URL opened by the "Open CUPS" button, through xdg-open.
cups_url.label: CUPS web interface

notify_on_fault.description: Show a notification the first time a printer reports itself as disabled or stopped.
notify_on_fault.label: Notify when a printer stops

poll_interval_seconds.description: How often lpstat is queried for printer states and the job queue.
poll_interval_seconds.label: Poll interval (seconds)

settings_command.description: The command run by the "Printer settings" button, e.g. system-config-printer. Arguments are split on spaces; it is not run through a shell.
settings_command.label: Printer settings command

show_when_idle.description: Keep the bar widget visible even when the queue is empty and no printer has stopped. Off by default, so it only appears when there is something to see.
show_when_idle.label: Always show the bar widget
